sloka: न जीवितम् मेऽस्ति पुनः कुतः सुखम् ।विनात्मजेनात्मवतः कुतो रतिः ।ममाहितम् देवि न क् कर्तुमर्हसि ।स्पृशामि पादावपि ते प्रसीद मे ॥२-१२-११३॥
transliteration: na jīvitam me'sti punaḥ kutaḥ sukham ।vinātmajenātmavataḥ kuto ratiḥ ।mamāhitam devi na k kartumarhasi ।spṛśāmi pādāvapi te prasīda me ॥2-12-113॥

translations.english: There is no life for me without my son (Rama). What to speak of happiness again? Where is pleasure for a selfrespecting man like me? O queen, it does not behove you to do this harmful act. I will touch your feet. Show pity on me.
